timeline.event: Hunter-gatherers begin carving the rock art of Alta
timeline.label: c. 4200 BCE

timeline.event: Viking raiders attack the monastery of Lindisfarne in England
The Oseberg ship is buried in a great mound near the Oslofjord
Harald Fairhair wins the Battle of Hafrsfjord
timeline.label: c. 872

timeline.event: King Olaf Haraldsson falls at the Battle of Stiklestad
Harald Hardrada is killed at Stamford Bridge in England
Norway cedes the Hebrides and Isle of Man to Scotland
The Black Death arrives in Bergen by ship
The Kalmar Union joins Norway, Denmark and Sweden under one monarch
The Lutheran Reformation is imposed on Norway
Christian IV rebuilds Oslo after a fire and renames it Christiania
Norway's constitution is signed at Eidsvoll
Fridtjof Nansen's Fram sets off to drift across the Arctic Ocean
Norway dissolves its union with Sweden
Roald Amundsen's team reaches the South Pole
Norwegian women win the vote on equal terms with men
Germany invades Norway
Oil is discovered at the Ekofisk field in the North Sea
Lillehammer hosts the Winter Olympics
The marble-roofed Oslo Opera House opens

places.name: Oslo
places.clue: Norway's capital, at the head of the Oslofjord, where the Nobel Peace Prize is awarded each December.

places.name: Bergen
places.clue: The 'city of seven mountains', whose colourful Hanseatic wharf, Bryggen, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.name: Geirangerfjord
places.clue: A UNESCO-listed fjord where the Seven Sisters waterfalls tumble down sheer cliffs.

places.name: North Cape
places.clue: A 307 m cliff on Magerøya island, famed as the northern tip of Europe and a place to watch the midnight sun.

places.name: Preikestolen
places.clue: Pulpit Rock, a flat-topped cliff about 604 m above the Lysefjord, reached by a popular hike.

places.name: Trondheim
places.clue: Medieval Nidaros, built around the cathedral over the grave of St Olaf, Norway's patron saint.

places.name: Tromsø
places.clue: The 'Gateway to the Arctic', a base for polar expeditions and one of the best places to see the northern lights.

places.name: Reine, Lofoten
places.clue: A fishing village of red rorbu cabins beneath jagged peaks, where cod dries on wooden racks in spring.

places.name: Røros
places.clue: A UNESCO-listed copper-mining town of wooden houses, mined for 333 years from 1644.

places.name: Urnes Stave Church
places.clue: A 12th-century stave church on the Lustrafjord, whose animal carvings gave their name to the Urnes style.

places.name: Saltstraumen
places.clue: A narrow strait near Bodø where one of the world's strongest tidal currents forms swirling whirlpools.

places.name: Alta Rock Art
places.clue: Thousands of prehistoric carvings of reindeer, boats and hunters, a UNESCO site near the Altafjord.
